about_short_description.short_description: Genuity is a one stop shop for managing all things IT and buying business software & services at the lowest possible price.

product.name: IT Help Desk
product.description: A cloud-based ticketing system for managing and resolving IT support requests within an organization.

product.name: IT Asset Management
product.description: A system to onboard, track, and manage all IT hardware and technology assets within an organization.

product.name: SaaS & Vendor Spend Management
product.description: A platform to manage software subscriptions, vendor contracts, usage, and compliance across an organization’s technology stack.

product.name: Contract Management
product.description: A tool to manage, track, and review IT contracts, licenses, and service agreements throughout their lifecycle.

product.name: Telecom Expense Management
product.description: A service to digitize and manage telecom expenses, helping organizations identify cost-saving opportunities.

product.name: Network Monitoring
product.description: Software to monitor network performance, uptime, and bandwidth usage, with alerting for issues and anomalies.
